courses.title: Software Engineering BSc
courses.summary: Foundations of building software well: from development processes and requirements through object-oriented design, patterns, architecture, and testing.
topics: Principles of object-oriented analysis and design. SOLID

laboratory.text: Lab assignments, with optional homework and presentations for extra credit, and a project.

courses.title: Verification and Validation
courses.summary: How to know software works: development, release, and user testing strategies, plus the test doubles used to isolate and verify behavior.
topics: Development testing: unit testing, component testing, system testing
Release testing: requirements-based testing, scenario-based testing
User testing: alpha testing, beta testing, acceptance testing
Test doubles: dummy object, test stub, test spy, mock objects

courses.title: Software Engineering MSc
courses.summary: Advanced, robustness-focused software engineering: defensive coding and design, better exception handling, advanced patterns, and optional types.
courses.laboratory: Lab & Project — follow the provided guide.
